title.ja: 非一様移動格子で実際に運ぶALEスカラー
title.en: ALE scalar transport on genuinely nonuniform moving cells

summary.ja: 質量と格子面位置を同じHeun段で更新し、一様GCLだけでなく非一様な解析波を運びます。
summary.en: Advance cell integrals and face positions with identical Heun stages, transporting a nonuniform analytic wave beyond a uniform GCL check.

assumptions.ja: 周期[0,1]、速度.7、q0=1+.2sin(2pi x)、面速度w=.2sin(2pi xi)cos(2pi t)、N40/80/160、T1。時間比較N40,T.25,32/64/128step。
assumptions.en: Periodic unit interval, speed.7,q0=1+.2sin(2pi x), grid speed .2sin(2pi xi)cos(2pi t),N40/80/160,T1. Separate N40,T.25 time series32/64/128steps.

algorithm.ja: 実セル質量の上流相対流束(a−w)qと実面位置を同じHeun predictor/correctorで進め、各段体積・面Courant数を記録。
algorithm.en: Upwind relative flux(a-w)q advances actual masses with identical predictor/corrector face geometry; record stage volumes and Courant numbers.

validation.ja: 解析的移動セル積分、全体/段の質量、GCLconstant、格子幾何誤差を分離。独立DOP853による同じFV ODEの時間参照を二公差で確認。
validation.en: Separate analytic moving-cell-integral error, global/stage mass, constant GCL and geometry error. Qualify an independent DOP853 integration of the same FV ODE with two tolerances.

limits.ja: 1D指定格子運動の第一段階です。図のx–tは2D物理計算ではなく、Euler Lagrange/remapやSaltzmanピストンは未実装の後続課題。
limits.en: First-stage1D prescribed mesh motion. The x–t image is not2D physics; Euler Lagrange/remap and Saltzman piston remain future work.

references.author: Dennis L. Huff
references.title: Numerical Simulations of Unsteady, Viscous, Transonic Flow Over Isolated and Cascaded Airfoils Using a Deforming Grid
references.review_scope: NASA TM89890 grid-velocity and GCL discussion around equation11/printedp5 inspected. It attributes GCL to Thomas/Lombard. Original1979 paper not read; no airfoil algorithm or code reproduced. Our 1D scalar moving-volume/Heun derivation is independent.

title.ja: 2D C-grid回転浅水波の実時間発展
title.en: Actual2D C-grid rotating shallow-water time advance

summary.ja: 実際の2D staggered場を時間積分し、連続波と離散symbolの参照を分けて比較します。
summary.en: Time-advance actual2D staggered fields and distinguish continuous-wave references from semidiscrete symbols.

assumptions.ja: 線形f-plane、g=H=f=1、周期単位正方形、(k,l)=(1,2)、eta振幅.01、N16/32/64,T.5。別の固定N16時間系列、zero-modeと離散geostrophic診断。
assumptions.en: Linear f-plane,g=H=f=1, periodic unit square, mode(1,2),height amplitude.01,N16/32/64,T.5. Separate N16 time refinement, zero-mode and discrete geostrophic probes.

algorithm.ja: セルeta・法線face u/vの差分と4点Coriolis補間を2Dで評価しRK4更新。3×3行列指数は参照だけで、PDE場の更新には使いません。
algorithm.en: Actual2D cell-height/face-velocity differences and four-point Coriolis interpolation use RK4. The3×3 matrix exponential is reference-only, never the PDE update.

validation.ja: 連続PDE空間誤差と離散symbol時間誤差、mass/energy、stencil-symbol一致、zero-mode慣性振動と離散定常釣合いを保存。
validation.en: Retain continuous-PDE spatial and discrete-symbol temporal errors, mass/energy, stencil-symbol identity, zero-mode inertia and discrete steady balance.

limits.ja: 線形・平面・周期squareの限定例。非線形浅水、PV・球面格子・全球dynamical coreやWilliamsonは未実装の後続課題。
limits.en: Linear planar periodic square only. Nonlinear SWE,PV,spherical dynamics and Williamson tests remain future work.

references.author: P. Korn and S. Danilov
references.title: Elementary dispersion analysis of some mimetic discretizations on triangular C-grids
references.review_scope: Governing linear equations, energy adjoints and AppendixB quadrilateral standard-C symbols/eq19–21 inspected. Use standard square C-grid only, not the paper triangular mimetic schemes. No global Williamson test or original code run.
